Score is a screening priority, not a confirmed leak. No metre-level localisation: the analysis grid is 20 m and the evidence is multi-date, not a single image. The pipeline enrichment test is not significant in this AOI (p > 0.05); the hotspots are candidates for field checking, not detections.
